pairing.scope: Metadata/sampler audit; future test samples are not used. Later batches reconstruct the original stateless sampler, not a saved full training trace.

preflight.split_audit_scope: Episode IDs and group IDs are disjoint across the existing splits. This is not an audit of exact or near-duplicate RGB clips; the original splits are unchanged.
preflight.sampling_contract: Available regime/mode/time strata balanced; episode uniform within strata; RGB/action/dt model inputs only
preflight.scope: Constant physical damping per trajectory tests a special case, not identification of genuine position/velocity-dependent damping. Opaque regime IDs, when present, are sampling metadata only. No damping coefficient or other physical target is read for training.
preflight.note: No training runs without --execute. The step budget is unprofiled, not an optimality or cost claim.

checks.timing_scope: Forward/backward with synchronized numerical/gradient auditing; no optimizer. Not training-step timing or ETA.
